newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: DHAKA STOCKS CLOSE LOWER ON RETAIL SELLING.
newsitem.headline: DHAKA STOCKS CLOSE LOWER ON RETAIL SELLING.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended lower on Tuesday as scrips eased across the board on selling pressure mostly from retail investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index dropped 8.34 points or 0.87 percent to 946.55 on turnover of 54.7 million taka. Losers led gainers by 103 to 33.

"The retail investors booked profit over the rises gained in previous two sessions. Engineering, food, pharmaceuticals and financial scrips lost heavily on profit taking," said one broker. Bangladesh Lamps lost 159 taka to 4,668, Beximco Pharma declined 0.64 to 129.07 and Eastern Insurance shed 10 to 240.
